scientific_limitations: Exact finite complete-graph and with-replacement homogeneous q-voter dynamics only.
Same susceptible population across comparisons; total population changes with the number of zealots.
The intermediate region establishes only failure of likelihood-ratio ordering, not incomparability in convex or stochastic order.
Original stationary mass formula is prior published work; the new claimed result is the joint sharp parameter-order phase diagram.
Historical priority and independent scientific validation have not been established.
title: A sharp two-control polarization order for finite symmetric q-voters
